pieces.name: Bias binding (neckline + armholes)
pieces.cut: cut 1 strip(s) 1231 x 25 mm ON THE BIAS (45° to the grain), join end to end (total 1231 mm = edge 1211 mm + overlap), press in half, wrap the edge and trim the excess

pieces.name: Drawstring Bust Panel (büzgü büst panosu)
pieces.cut: cut 1 rectangle(s) 244 x 140 mm (join to a 214 mm flat top edge that gathers down to 119 mm), gathered drawstring at the bust

pieces.name: Drawstring Cord (büzgü bağı)
pieces.cut: cut 1 rectangle 54 x 649 mm (finished 12 x 619 mm), self-fabric cord threaded through the casing
